submission_results.hypothesis: Observation: MocksSerializationTest chains withSettings().serializable().extraInterfaces(List.class), and the mock is not serializable. Cause: MockSettingsImpl.extraInterfaces assigns this.extraInterfaces = extraInterfaces, which overwrites the earlier java.io.Serializable entry added by serializable(), so isSerializable() returns false. Fix: merge new interfaces into the existing array instead of replacing it. Parent is the original tree. Refutation: if the test still throws NotSerializableException, the cause lies elsewhere, e.g. in the CGLIB proxy class creation in ClassImposterizer.
